Focaccia dough proved twice, dimpled with olive oil, rosemary and sea salt, baked at 220C for 20 minutes until golden. Mix 500g bread flour, 7g dried yeast, 10g salt and 400ml lukewarm water into a wet dough and rest 30 minutes. Stretch and fold it 4 times over the next hour, then pour 60ml olive oil into a 30 x 20cm tin, tip in the dough and leave to rise 1 hour. Dimple all over with oiled fingers, push in rosemary sprigs, drizzle with more oil and sprinkle with sea salt. Bake at 220C for 20 minutes until deep golden.
M: the pasta-eating leg of the Portorosso Cup
Linguine cooked with sliced potato and green beans in the same pot, drained and tossed with fresh pesto of basil, pine nuts, garlic and parmesan.
Riviera fish, prawn and mussel stew
the little fishing town on the Italian Riviera

Fish, prawns and mussels simmered in a tomato, garlic and white wine broth for 10 minutes until the shells open, with crusty bread. Soften 1 sliced onion, 1 sliced fennel bulb and 4 sliced garlic cloves in olive oil for 8 minutes. Add a pinch of chilli, a 400g tin crushed tomatoes and 650ml fish stock and simmer 15 minutes. Add 500g firm white fish in chunks and 8 green prawns, simmer 3 minutes, then add 500g cleaned mussels, cover and cook 4 to 5 minutes until the shells open. Throw away any that stay shut. Finish with parsley and serve with toasted crusty bread.
W: Ricotta, lemon zest, eggs and sugar beaten smooth, self-raising flour folded in, baked at 170C for 45 minutes and dusted with icing sugar.
K: Fresh lemon juice shaken with a basil sugar syrup, topped with soda water over ice and finished with a strip of lemon peel and basil. Simmer 100g caster sugar and 100ml water until dissolved, take off the heat, add a handful of basil leaves and steep 15 minutes, then strain and chill. Mix the syrup with the juice of 4 lemons. Fill 4 glasses with ice, divide the lemon mix between them and top with 700ml cold soda water. Twist a strip of lemon peel over each glass, drop it in and add a small basil sprig.

s.note: Luca and Alberto trying gelato for the first time
s.how: Scoop vanilla ice cream and lemon sorbet side by side into small cups. Crush amaretti biscuits over the top and finish with a little lemon zest. Eat them fast on a hot Italian summer afternoon in the town square.

s.note: Giulia's dad Massimo working the harbour
s.how: Grate 3 zucchini and squeeze dry. Mix with 200g ricotta, an egg, 50g grated parmesan and 80g flour. Fry spoonfuls in olive oil until golden on both sides. Serve with lemon wedges by the harbour.

m.note: the pasta-eating leg of the Portorosso Cup
m.how: Blitz 2 bunches basil with 50g pine nuts, a garlic clove, 50g parmesan and olive oil into pesto. Cook 500g linguine with sliced potato and green beans in the same pot. Drain and toss with the pesto. Simple Ligurian food.

w.how: Beat 500g ricotta with 150g sugar, 3 eggs and the zest of 2 lemons until smooth. Fold in 150g self-raising flour. Pour into a lined tin and bake at 170C for 45 minutes until set. Cool and dust with icing sugar.

d.how: Simmer 100g caster sugar and 100ml water until dissolved, take off the heat, add a handful of basil leaves and steep 15 minutes, then strain and chill. Mix the syrup with the juice of 4 lemons. Fill 4 glasses with ice, divide the lemon mix between them and top with 700ml cold soda water. Twist a strip of lemon peel over each glass, drop it in and add a small basil sprig.
